entries.resolution: added clarification for flow set step id and status validation, target-step validator scope, and non-zero failure behavior

entries.reason: scenario-validity classified every requirement as invalid_test because the spec-local tests imported a missing module directly
entries.resolution: changed the test loader to assert the module path exists before importing so pre-implementation absence is an expected assertion failure
